issue_title: Planner: surface open PR review queue in maintainer plans
issue_body:
## Problem / motivation

The maintainer's working surface at freeze time T often includes **open pull requests** awaiting review or merge. Today `agent/planner.py` renders open PRs in the context JSON but does not instruct the model to treat them as first-class planning inputs — so plans frequently ignore the PR queue and jump straight to new work.

Strong maintainers typically clear or explicitly schedule review of open PRs before greenfield features.

## Proposed solution

Update `agent/planner.py` so the planning prompt:

- Summarizes the open PR queue (count + titles) when `open_prs` is non-empty.
- Requires at least one plan item to address the PR backlog (review, merge, or request changes) when PRs are open.
- Uses `kind: "triage"` or an appropriate kind for PR-review items.

## Acceptance criteria

- When `open_prs` is present in context, offline/live planning produces at least one item referencing an open PR title or explicit PR review.
- When no PRs are open, behavior is unchanged (no forced PR items).
- Existing offline smoke tests still pass.

## Area

agent capability
